t: AI Resource Economics: Circular Flow Optimizer — Simple
name: AI Resource Economics: Circular Flow Optimizer — Simple
title: AI Resource Economics: Circular Flow Optimizer — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] An optimizer that keeps materials in use: it maps waste streams to input needs across firms, prices the exchanges, and routes byproducts to their highest-value reuse. Waste is a resource priced at zero by mistake.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Exchange throughput: 4 cores x 3 GHz x 8 ipc x 64 bits = 6144.0 Gbps. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Resource Management & Economic Optimization + Resource Optimization & Sustainable Living + Resource Optimization for Planetary Survival
real_world_basis: Industrial symbiosis exchanges operate in several countries with measured waste reductions.
signature_version: Signature version: the economics Balance assessor — the chapter's A7 Balance (throughput vs circularity) scored per industrial park, with the 'universal' framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: register waste streams honestly first, match to needs, then clear the market per period.
math_note: Exchange throughput: 4 cores x 3 GHz x 8 ipc x 64 bits: 6144.0 Gbps [verified]; Circular share: 100 units at 12% for 10 years: 310.6 units [verified]

safety: Fairness safety: small firms get equal access to the exchange — no preferential matching for large players.

t: AI Resource Economics: Scarcity Pricer — Simple

title: AI Resource Economics: Scarcity Pricer — Simple
description:
